fullPassage: While you're unlikely to receive an email from a vegetable, it's not impossible. A team of engineers placed special devices in spinach plants that emit a signal when they sense nitroaromatic compounds in the soil. These components are commonly found in explosives. The signal causes a small computer to send an email to the engineers. The goal of this study was to find out if spinach could detect explosives, but the technology involved has broader potential. It is possible that it can be used to help scientists gather vital information about environmental conditions. The engineers believe plants have the ability to predict upcoming droughts, as well as more subtle changes in soil and water, as they grow. They could also be useful in detecting pollution and combating climate change.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) unlikely=~할 것 같지 않은 / likely=~할 것 같은 (B) commonly=흔히 / rarely=드물게 (C) broader=더 넓은 / narrower=더 좁은
det.analysis:
① unlikely—commonly—broader: 채소에게 이메일 받을 일은 없을 것 같지만, 그 성분은 폭발물에서 흔히 발견되며, 기술은 더 넓은 잠재력이 있다 ←정답
② likely: 이메일을 '받을 것 같다'? 본문은 unlikely(받을 것 같지 않다)
③ rarely/narrower: 드물게 발견/더 좁은 잠재력은 문맥과 반대
④ likely/rarely/narrower: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 채소에게 이메일 받을 일은 없을 것 같지만(unlikely), 성분이 흔히(commonly) 발견되고, 더 넓은(broader) 잠재력이 있다는 흐름

det.korean: find(동사: 발견하다) → found (과거분사, 수동태 be found)
det.analysis:
find를 과거분사 found로 변환. 'are commonly found' = '흔히 발견된다' — be + p.p. 수동태 구문이므로 과거분사가 필요
주어(components)가 '발견되는' 대상이므로 능동이 아닌 수동
det.tip: are commonly _____ → 수동태(be + p.p.) → found

questions.passage: The engineers believe plants have the ability to predict upcoming droughts, as well as more subtle changes in soil and water, as they grow. They could also be useful in __________ (detect) pollution and combating climate change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: detect(동사: 감지하다) → detecting (동명사, 전치사 in 뒤 + combating과 병렬)
det.analysis:
detect를 동명사 detecting으로 변환. 전치사 in 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하고, 뒤의 combating과 등위(and) 병렬 구조를 이루므로 -ing 형태가 필요
'useful in detecting ... and combating' = '~을 감지하고 ~에 맞서 싸우는 데 유용한'
det.tip: 전치사 in 뒤 + combating과 병렬 → 동명사(-ing) → detecting

questions.passage: While you're unlikely to receive an email from a vegetable, it's not impossible. A team of engineers placed special devices in spinach plants that emit a signal when they sense nitroaromatic compounds in the soil. These components are commonly found in explosives. The signal causes a small computer to send an email to the engineers. The goal of this study was to find out if spinach could detect explosives, but the technology involved has broader potential. It is possible that it can be used to help scientists gather vital information about environmental conditions. The engineers believe plants have the ability to predict upcoming droughts, as well as more subtle changes in soil and water, as they grow. They could also be useful in detecting pollution and combating __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: climate change=기후변화 / small computer=작은 컴퓨터 / spinach plants=시금치 식물 / nitroaromatic compounds=질소방향족 화합물
det.analysis:
① climate change: 오염을 탐지하고 기후변화에 맞서 싸우는 데 유용하다 ←정답
② small computer: 작은 컴퓨터에 맞서 싸운다? 문맥 부적절
③ spinach plants: 시금치 식물에 맞서 싸운다? 문맥 부적절
④ nitroaromatic compounds: 화합물에 맞서 싸운다? 앞의 detecting pollution 흐름과 안 맞음
det.tip: detecting pollution and combating __________ = 기후변화(climate change)에 맞서 싸우다

The engineers believe plants have the ability to predict upcoming droughts, as well as more subtle changes in soil and water, as they grow. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

④ small computers: 작은 컴퓨터에 관한 정보? 문맥 부적절
det.tip: gather vital information about __________ = 환경 조건(environmental conditions)에 관한 정보
